connection.title: Can't reach the PingPath service
connection.not_running: The PingPath service isn't running. It starts with Windows; if it doesn't, reinstall PingPath.
connection.access_denied: Windows didn't let this window talk to the PingPath service, which answers only people signed in to this PC. Start PingPath from the Start menu rather than as another user or from a script, and try again.
connection.lost: Lost the connection to the PingPath service.
connection.failed: Couldn't connect to the PingPath service.
connection.version_mismatch: This window and the PingPath service are different versions. Reinstall PingPath.
connection.too_many_connections: Too many PingPath windows are open. Close the others and try again.
connection.refused: The PingPath service refused the connection.
game.heading: Game
game.none: No games yet. The list comes from the PingPath service.
game.none_routable: None of these games can be optimized yet: PingPath routes a game only after it has been tested with its anti-cheat.
game.reason.untested: Not tested with its anti-cheat yet, so PingPath never routes it.
game.reason.unsupported: Its rules don't allow tools like PingPath, so PingPath never routes it.
game.reason.shares_ranges: It shares server addresses with a game PingPath never routes, so PingPath never routes it either.
game.locked: Turn Optimize off to change the game or region.
region.label: Region
region.not_usual: {name}: not a region you normally use
region.not_usual_note: Greyed regions are far from you. PingPath only optimizes the regions you would normally play in.
measure.hint: Measure to compare your direct ping with PingPath.
compare.heading: Ping
compare.not_better: Your direct route is already about as good, so Optimize won't turn on.
compare.no_path: No PingPath route reaches this region yet.
compare.not_usual: This region is far from you, so PingPath won't optimize it: it only optimizes the regions you would normally play in.
compare.direct_unknown: Your direct ping couldn't be measured, so there's nothing to compare with.
optimize.heading: Optimize
optimize.mode.optimized: On: your game's traffic goes through PingPath.
optimize.unknown: Unknown while the PingPath service can't be reached.
optimize.match_note: Turn it on before joining a match. Switching it on or off during a match may need a reconnect: Windows keeps a match's connection on the route it started with, and some games tie a match to your address.
optimize.another_user: Another user of this PC turned Optimize on. Only they can change it.
optimize.not_better: Optimize turns on only when PingPath beats your direct route by the margin set in Settings.
session.no_traffic: No game traffic yet: rejoin the match.
warning.title: {game} is still being tested
warning.body: PingPath is still testing {game} with its anti-cheat. PingPath never touches the game, only the way its traffic reaches the servers, but until testing ends we can't promise it is safe for your account.
warning.question: Turn Optimize on for this game anyway? You'll only be asked once.
graph.heading: Live
graph.empty: The graph starts after you measure or turn Optimize on.
graph.aria: Ping, jitter and packet loss over the last two minutes
notice.another_user: These notices are about the session another user of this PC turned on; only they can dismiss them.
notice.fell_back: Optimize turned itself off, so your game now connects directly. Some games need to reconnect.
notice.cause.exit_not_forwarding: The relay stopped delivering your game's traffic.
notice.cause.session_expired: The session couldn't be renewed in time.
notice.cause.session_ended: The session reached its twelve-hour limit; turn Optimize on again to carry on.
notice.cause.renewal_refused: PingPath's server didn't renew the session.
notice.cause.engine_stalled: The PingPath service stopped responding, so its routes were removed.
notice.address_changed: The relay restarted, so the game server now sees a new address. Some games need to reconnect.
notice.failed_over: PingPath moved to another relay ({entry}). The game server saw no change.
notice.failed_over_direct: PingPath now goes straight to the exit relay. The game server saw no change.
notice.not_better: Optimize stayed off: your direct ping ({direct}) is already as good as PingPath's ({optimized}).
notice.direct_unknown: Optimize stayed off: your direct ping couldn't be measured, so there was nothing to compare with.
notice.game_traffic_blocked: {packets} of the game's packets couldn't be carried (not UDP, to other ports, or too large) and were blocked while optimized. Please send a diagnostic report.
refusal.not_routable_untested: {game} hasn't been tested with its anti-cheat yet, so PingPath never routes it.
refusal.not_routable_unsupported: {game}'s rules don't allow tools like PingPath, so PingPath never routes it.
refusal.shares_ranges_with_refused_game: {game} shares server addresses with a game PingPath never routes.
error.owned_by_another_user: Another user of this PC turned Optimize on. Only they can change it.
error.hello_required: The window and the service got out of step. Try again.
error.version_mismatch: This window and the PingPath service are different versions. Reinstall PingPath.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error.too_many_requests: Your last request is still running. Wait for it to finish.
error.too_many_connections: Too many PingPath windows are open. Close the others and try again.
error.invalid_settings: Those settings are out of range.
error.cannot_save: The setting applies until the service restarts, but it couldn't be saved.
error.bad_request: The service didn't understand the request.
error.direct_unknown: Your direct ping couldn't be measured, so there's nothing to compare with.
error.not_usual_region: That isn't a region you normally use, so PingPath won't route the game there.
error.warning_not_acknowledged: Accept the warning for this game first.
error.no_path: No PingPath route reaches this region yet.
error.not_better: Your direct route is already as good, so Optimize stayed off.
error.busy: PingPath is busy with something else. Try again in a moment.
error.control: PingPath's server couldn't be reached, or it refused the request.
error.platform: Windows couldn't set up PingPath's network adapter or routes.
error.service_unavailable: The PingPath service can't be reached.
error.disconnected: The connection to the service closed before it answered.
error.timeout: The service didn't answer in time.
error.report_failed: The report could be neither copied nor saved.
error.doctor_busy: A network check is already running, perhaps in another PingPath window. Wait for it to finish.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.verbose_note: Logs more detail, for reporting a problem. Turn it off afterwards.
settings.stability_note: Sends each game packet through two relays, so a lost packet or a failing relay costs nothing. Uses up to twice the game's data. Automatic turns it on only while the connection shows loss or jitter.
settings.thresholds_note: Optimize turns on only if PingPath beats your direct route by at least this much. Either one is enough.
settings.control_url_note: Set by an administrator in PingPath's settings file.
settings.service_unavailable: The service's settings show up once it is connected.
settings.report_note: Collects PingPath's recent logs into one file to send with a problem report. Public IP addresses are shortened and your home folder is hidden; read it before sharing it.
settings.report_copied_saved: Copied to the clipboard and saved to {path}.
settings.report_saved: Saved to {path}; it couldn't be copied to the clipboard.
notify.fell_back.title: Optimize turned off
notify.fell_back.body: Optimize turned itself off, so your game now connects directly. Some games need to reconnect.
notify.address_changed.title: The game server sees a new address
notify.address_changed.body: The relay restarted. Some games need to reconnect.
notify.lost.title: PingPath lost touch with its service
notify.lost.body: Optimize may have turned off, so your game may now connect directly. Some games need to reconnect. Open PingPath to see more.
notify.hidden.title: PingPath is still on
notify.hidden.body: Optimize stays on with the window closed. Use the PingPath icon in the notification area to open it or to turn Optimize off.
router.heading: Turn on SQM on your router
router.intro: Bufferbloat happens when your connection is busy and the router lets a long queue of packets build up. SQM (Smart Queue Management, sometimes called QoS or Smart QoS) keeps that queue short by sending a little below your line's speed, so game packets don't wait behind downloads. PingPath only shows the steps; it never changes your router.
router.speeds: Set download to about {download} and upload to about {upload}: 90% of what the test measured. Run the test again afterwards; if the grade is still poor, lower both a little.
router.speeds_unknown: Set download and upload to about 90% of your line's speeds (the bufferbloat test measures them).
router.other.name: Other, or not sure
router.other.steps:
Open your router's settings page: usually http://192.168.1.1 or http://192.168.0.1. The address and password are often on a label on the router.
Look for QoS, SQM, Smart QoS, Bandwidth control or Traffic management.
If it asks for your speeds, enter the numbers above. If it only sets priorities, give this PC the highest priority.
Save, then run the bufferbloat test again.
If the router your internet provider gave you has no such setting, a router of your own with SQM (OpenWrt, for example) can be plugged in behind it.
router.asus.name: ASUS
router.asus.steps:
Open http://router.asus.com and sign in.
Go to Adaptive QoS > QoS.
Turn on Enable QoS and pick a QoS type that asks for your speeds (Traditional QoS on most models).
Enter the upload and download bandwidth above.
Select Apply.
router.tplink.name: TP-Link
router.tplink.steps:
Open http://tplinkwifi.net and sign in.
Go to Advanced > QoS.
Turn on QoS and enter the upload and download bandwidth above.
If the page offers it, add this PC as a high-priority device.
Save. On a Deco system, use the Deco app: More > QoS.
router.netgear.name: NETGEAR
router.netgear.steps:
Open http://routerlogin.net and sign in.
Go to Advanced > Setup > QoS Setup.
Turn on QoS and choose to enter your speeds yourself rather than have the router measure them.
Enter the upload and download bandwidth above.
Select Apply.
router.huawei.name: Huawei
router.huawei.steps:
Open http://192.168.3.1 (or the HUAWEI AI Life app) and sign in.
Go to More functions and look for QoS, Game acceleration or Network acceleration.
Turn it on. If it asks for your speeds, enter the numbers above.
Save.
router.zte.name: ZTE
router.zte.steps:
Open http://192.168.1.1 and sign in. The password is often on the router's label.
Look for QoS under Application, Network or Advanced.
Turn it on, and enter the upload and download speeds above if it asks for them.
Save. Routers supplied by an internet provider sometimes hide this setting; a router of your own with SQM can sit behind it.
router.dlink.name: D-Link
router.dlink.steps:
Open http://192.168.0.1 and sign in.
Go to Features > QoS Engine (on some models, Advanced > QoS).
Turn it on and enter the upload and download speeds above.
Give this PC the highest priority.
Save.
router.linksys.name: Linksys
router.linksys.steps:
Open http://myrouter.local (or http://192.168.1.1) and sign in.
Go to Media Prioritization (on some models, QoS).
Turn it on and, if it asks for your speeds, enter the numbers above.
Move this PC to the high-priority list.
Save.
router.mikrotik.name: MikroTik
router.mikrotik.steps:
Open WinBox or WebFig.
In Queues > Queue Types, add a queue type of kind cake (RouterOS 7) or fq-codel.
In Queues > Simple Queues, add a queue for your local network with Max Limit set to the upload and download speeds above, using the new queue type both ways.
Apply.
router.ubiquiti.name: Ubiquiti (UniFi, EdgeRouter)
router.ubiquiti.steps:
Open the UniFi Network app (or the EdgeRouter's web page).
UniFi: Settings > Internet, then your internet connection. EdgeRouter: QoS > Smart Queue.
Turn on Smart Queues and enter the download and upload speeds above.
Apply.
router.openwrt.name: OpenWrt
router.openwrt.steps:
Open LuCI (usually http://192.168.1.1).
In System > Software, install luci-app-sqm.
Go to Network > SQM QoS, pick your internet (WAN) interface and enable the instance.
Enter the download and upload speeds above, and under Queue Discipline choose cake with piece_of_cake.qos.
Save & Apply.
doctor.heading: Network check
doctor.intro: Checks your connection at home: Wi-Fi or cable, programs using the network, DNS, and bufferbloat (how much your ping rises when the connection is busy). It takes about a minute, and the bufferbloat test fills your connection for about 20 seconds, so don't run it during a match. PingPath changes nothing; it tells you what to fix.
doctor.summary.background: Everything on this PC together: {down} down, {up} up, over {secs} seconds
doctor.summary.dns: {address}: first answers in {first}, from its cache in {cached}
doctor.dns_note: DNS doesn't change your ping in a match; it changes how fast games and launchers connect.
doctor.finding.ethernet: You're connected by cable: steadier than Wi-Fi.
doctor.finding.wifi_fix: Wi-Fi adds jitter and short bursts of packet loss that a cable doesn't. If you can, connect this PC to the router with an Ethernet cable; if not, play closer to the router.
doctor.finding.weak_signal: The Wi-Fi signal is weak ({rssi_dbm} dBm).
doctor.finding.weak_signal_fix: Move closer to the router, or clear what's between you (walls, metal, mirrors, aquariums), or add a mesh point or access point near this PC. Below −67 dBm, packets start getting lost.
doctor.finding.crowded_band_fix: It's crowded and slower. If your router has a 5 GHz network (often the same name with "5G" at the end), connect to that instead.
doctor.finding.slow_link: The cable connection runs at only {mbps} Mbit/s.
doctor.finding.slow_link_fix: That usually means a damaged cable or a port stuck at 10 Mbit/s. Try another cable (Cat 5e or better) or another port on the router.
doctor.finding.virtual_adapter: Your internet traffic goes through {adapter}, a virtual adapter: another VPN or a virtual switch.
doctor.finding.virtual_adapter_fix: Another VPN adds its own delay and can get in PingPath's way. Turn it off while you play. The other checks measure that adapter, not your line.
doctor.finding.dns_none: No DNS server is set for your connection.
doctor.finding.dns_none_fix: Without one, games and launchers can't find their servers. In Windows Settings > Network & internet, set DNS back to automatic, or restart the router.
doctor.finding.dns_unanswered: Your DNS server ({address}) didn't answer {unanswered} of {asked} lookups.
doctor.finding.dns_unanswered_fix: Restart your router. If it keeps happening, set a public DNS server in Windows: Settings > Network & internet > your connection > DNS server assignment.
doctor.finding.dns_slow_cached: Your DNS server ({address}) is slow even for names it already knows: {ms}.
doctor.finding.dns_slow_cached_fix: It's far away or overloaded. Restarting the router often helps; otherwise use a faster DNS server.
doctor.finding.dns_slow_first: Your DNS server ({address}) takes {ms} to look names up.
doctor.finding.dns_slow_first_fix: Restarting the router often helps; otherwise use a faster DNS server.
doctor.finding.dns_faster_public_fix: To use it: Windows Settings > Network & internet > your connection > DNS server assignment > Edit, choose Manual, and enter {address}.
doctor.finding.bufferbloat_grade: Bufferbloat grade {grade}: your ping rises by {download_ms} while downloading and {upload_ms} while uploading.
doctor.finding.bufferbloat_grade_good_fi: Your connection stays responsive when it's busy.
doctor.finding.bufferbloat_grade_fair_fi: Games may lag a little when someone on your connection downloads or uploads. Turning on SQM on your router would help; see below.
doctor.finding.bufferbloat_grade_poor_fi: Games lag whenever someone on your connection downloads, uploads or streams. Turning on SQM on your router fixes this; see below.
doctor.finding.sqm_suggested: Turn on SQM on your router, set to about {download} down and {upload} up.
doctor.finding.sqm_suggested_fix: The steps for your router are below.
doctor.finding.no_test_server: No test server is available right now.
doctor.finding.no_test_server_fix: The bufferbloat test needs one of PingPath's servers near you. Try again later.
doctor.finding.test_limit_reached: Your network has run the bufferbloat test several times recently.
doctor.finding.test_limit_reached_fix: To keep the test servers' costs down, each network may run it a few times an hour. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
doctor.finding.background_share: Background traffic used {pct}% of your connection's speed during the check.
doctor.finding.background_share_fix: Your game shares the connection with it. Pause the programs listed under Background traffic while you play.
doctor.finding.stop_optimizing: The bufferbloat test doesn't run while a game is optimized.
doctor.finding.stop_optimizing_fix: It fills your connection for about 20 seconds, which would make your game lag. Turn Optimize off, run the check, then turn it back on.
doctor.finding.background_quiet: Nothing else on this PC is using the network much.
doctor.finding.background_launcher: {name} is downloading or updating ({down} down, {up} up).
doctor.finding.background_launcher_fix: Pause downloads and updates in {name} while you play, or set a download limit in its settings.
doctor.finding.background_sync_fix: Pause syncing while you play: right-click its icon in the notification area.
doctor.finding.background_update: Windows services ({name}) are using the network ({down} down, {up} up), often for Windows Update.
doctor.finding.background_update_fix: In Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Delivery Optimization, limit the bandwidth it may use, or pause updates while you play.
doctor.finding.background_browser: {name} is using the network ({down} down, {up} up), usually for a video or a download.
doctor.finding.background_browser_fix: Close video tabs and pause downloads while you play.
doctor.finding.background_streaming_fix: Streaming takes upload speed your game needs too. Lower the stream's bitrate, or run the check with it on to see what it costs.
doctor.finding.background_other: {name} is using the network ({down} down, {up} up).
doctor.finding.background_other_fix: If you don't need it while you play, close it or pause what it's doing.
doctor.finding.not_supported: This check doesn't run on this computer.
doctor.finding.check_failed_fix: Try again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report in Settings and send it to us.
